observations: Across museum flying-fish specimens, pectoral fin length scales with standard length as SL^b with the exponent inside its 95% CI [1.017, 1.099] (OLS on log-log, n = 49, b = 1.058, r^2 = 0.983).
caveats: preserved museum specimens; pooled across species (between-species and ontogenetic variation mixed)
OLS, not RMA; the CI is the slope CI of y = pectoral on x = SL
SL spans 1.68 to 24 cm, so larvae/juveniles are included
